title: Hero statistics
description: The four figures in the hero band. These must be generated rather than written into the static shell: index.html is both the build's input and its output, so a {{fact:}} token left in the shell resolves on the first build and is written back as a literal — working once and then silently freezing. Anything token-bearing belongs inside a BUILD anchor.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema file.

stats.description: DISPLAY ORDER IS ARRAY ORDER. Rendered with a divider between each.

fact_ref.description: Id in facts.json supplying the number. The stat renders that fact's display value, so the hero cannot drift from the rest of the site.

link_url.description: Page to open when the stat is clicked, e.g. '/gov-101'. When set the stat renders as a plain <a>; when null it renders as a div. It used to switch an Explore tab in the single-page layout — now that each section has its own page, it is an ordinary link.
